title: English Academic Writing 1
subtitle: English Academic Writing 1
courseType:
English Language Program
English Language Courses
educationalGoal: In Academic English Writing 1, students will acquire English writing skills by studying and applying the writing techniques necessary to write an academic research paper. They will be able to choose an appropriate research topic and gather information on it. They will compose a research paper according to the rules of style, organization, formatting, and citation.
advice: In this course, students will acquire academic writing skills in the following areas: (1) Choosing a topic (2) Gathering information (research) (3) Composing a research paper (4) Plagiarism (5) Incorporating internet tools (AI) Students are required to actively participate in the class.
requiredKnowledge: Native-level English fluency and basic computer skills are required.

activityGoals.body: Gather information relevant to the research topic.
Understand the structure and format of English-language research papers.
Be able to use academic English vocabulary and grammatical structures.
Become familiar with internet/AI tools to aid in writing research papers.

achievementLevels.ideal: -Students can confidently choose appropriate research topics relevant to their fields of study. -Students can gather good information relevant to their research topics from reliable sources. -Students can apply the rules of structure and formatting associated with academic English writing. -Students can seamlessly incorporate vocabulary and grammatical structures appropriate for academic English writing. -Students exhibit proficiency in using online/AI tools to aid in research and academic English writing.
achievementLevels.standard: -Students exhibit some ability to choose research topics relevant to their fields of study. -Students can gather adequate information relevant to their research topics. -Students show general familiarity with the rules of structure and formatting associated with academic English writing. -Students demonstrate some ability to use vocabulary and grammatical structures appropriate for academic English writing. -Students are aware of some online/AI tools that aid in research and academic English writing.
